people.title: People
people.none: Nobody else is in your groups yet.
people.removeNote: Somebody you remove cannot come back with a link.
people.failed: That did not save. Try again.

welcome.title: Three questions and you are shopping
welcome.body: You do not have to answer any of them. If you skip a question, we choose for you, and you can change it later.
welcome.oneBody: The name everyone in your groups sees.
welcome.twoBody: A postal code. Without one we cannot show a price.
welcome.threeBody: All of them, until you say otherwise.

name.title: What do we call you?
name.body: Everyone in your groups sees this name. It is not your email address, and it does not have to be your real name.
name.label: Your name
name.picked: We already picked one for you.
name.keeps: Leave the field blank and it stays yours.
name.note: You can change it later on your account screen. Names are not unique, so somebody else can be {{name}} too.

place.title: Where do you shop?
place.body: The same product costs different amounts in different towns, so we cannot show you a price until we know which shops are near you. A postal code is as close as we ever need.
place.privacy: If you press the button, your position is turned into a postal code and the position is thrown away. We store the code and nothing finer.
place.nearbyBody: A shop one street over is often in the next code. Ticked because you just told us where you are.
place.reachesBody: You choose between them on the next screen.
place.skipTitle: Without a postal code the catalog still works and shows no prices.
place.skipBody: Lists, groups and the assistant are unaffected. Add a code whenever you like, on your shopping profile.

shops.title: Which supermarkets?
shops.body: All of them are on. Turn off a chain you will never walk into, and its prices stop counting anywhere in the app.
shops.note: A chain means every shop it has here. Refuse one shop on its own later, on your shopping profile.
shops.noneTitle: With every chain off, nothing has a price.
shops.noneBody: The catalog, your lists and the assistant all keep working. Turn one back on whenever you like.

done.title: That is everything
done.body: Each answer is already saved. Change any of them from your account screen.
done.name: Name
done.tourTitle: Would you like a quick tour?
done.tourBody: We will show you around the app, one screen at a time, so that nothing is hard to find. It is short, and you can stop it whenever you like.

nav.title: These three take you everywhere
nav.body: Home is where you are now. Catalog is every product in the shops near you. Shopping list is what you take to the supermarket.

groups.title: A group is who you shop with
groups.body: Your household, your family, the flat you share. Everybody in it sees the same lists at the same time.

lists.title: Inside a group are lists
lists.body: A list is what a group is running out of. Anybody in the group can add to it, from anywhere.

basket.title: One list for the whole trip
basket.body: Velista puts everything your groups need into one list, and tells you which shop sells each thing cheapest. You tick things off as you put them in the trolley.

assistant.title: Ask instead of looking
assistant.body: Tell Velista what you need in your own words, the way you would tell a person. It writes it on the right list for you.

voice.title: Say it instead of typing it
voice.body: Hold the microphone and say what is missing. It is the quickest way to add something with your hands full.
